title: The source
html:
00 Source

  • 明孝宗實錄, 劉健等修. 臺北: 中央研究院歷史語言研究所, 1966 (校印本). A photographic reproduction of the 國立北平圖書館藏紅格鈔本 (the "red-grid manuscript"), enlarged from microfilm. The edition says the manuscript lacks the table of contents, which was copied from the 抱經樓本.
  • The PDF is in the author's reference library. 4,310 pages, 1634 by 2400 pt, scans only, no text layer. sha256 begins dcf25596040c084b.
  • Each page is one half-leaf: 10 columns of up to 20 characters. The margin, added in 1966, gives 明孝宗實錄, the juan (卷一〇七), the leaf, and a running page number (0001-4252).
  • Not used for the text: 黃彰健, 明孝宗實錄校勘記. Modern scholarship, kept for checking only.

The PDF itself is not copied here. Why we start from the scan: see ../JOURNAL.md.
